text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe was more ripe for investment than it was two years ago and would seek targeted investment from Britain in critical areas of the economy, President Robert Mugabe said in London on Monday.
- Zimbabwe's tourism industry has hailed the commissioning of Harare's new airport project, saying this will boost the industry.
- The Supreme Court ruled on Tuesday that civil servants could not stand for election as city councillors or mayors without permission from their superiors.
